verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a hosted HTTP API (`https://serpapi.com/search?engine=google`) authenticated by API key, with official client libraries, JSON/markdown output and an async submit-and-retrieve-later mode, so it runs non-interactively in scripts and pipelines by design. Community users confirm it is widely used programmatically by scripts and AI tools. The legacy Python package is being deprecated, but a successor library is documented. missing for 10: CI-specific documentation (e.g. env-var/secret-based key configuration, CI pipeline examples), hands-on corroboration of use in CI runners.
